description: Nd₃NaPtO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.67 Å. There are three inequivalent Nd sites. In the first Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.57 Å. In the second Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.71 Å. In the third Nd site, Nd is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Nd-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.64 Å. Pt is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Pt-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.09 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Nd atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaNd₃ trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, three Nd, and one Pt atom to form distorted ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONaNd₃Pt square pyramids, corners with five ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaNd₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with three ONaNd₃Pt square pyramids, edges with five ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaNd₃ trigonal pyramid. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, three Nd, and one Pt atom to form distorted ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONaNd₃Pt square pyramids, corners with five ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaNd₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with three ONaNd₃Pt square pyramids, edges with five ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaNd₃ trigonal pyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, three Nd, and one Pt atom to form distorted ONaNd₃Pt square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONaNd₃Pt square pyramid, corners with eight ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaNd₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ONaNd₃Pt square pyramids, edges with six ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaNd₃ trigonal pyramid. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na, three Nd, and one Pt atom to form distorted ONaNd₃Pt square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONaNd₃Pt square pyramid, corners with eight ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaNd₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ONaNd₃Pt square pyramids, edges with six ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaNd₃ trigonal pyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, three Nd, and one Pt atom to form distorted ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONaNd₃Pt square pyramids, corners with five ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaNd₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with three ONaNd₃Pt square pyramids, edges with five ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaNd₃ trigonal pyramid. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to one Na, three Nd, and one Pt atom to form distorted ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four ONaNd₃Pt square pyramids, corners with five ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent ONaNd₃ trigonal pyramids, edges with three ONaNd₃Pt square pyramids, edges with five ONaNd₃Pt trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaNd₃ trigonal pyramid.
